project.name: career-ops
project.identity: A human-in-the-loop job search command center that turns official postings into evidence-bound fit evaluations, tailored materials, tracker records, and draft-only outreach.
project.audience: Job seekers who want a governed, evidence-backed application workflow rather than spray-and-pray automation.
project.core_loop: Resolve an official posting, evaluate fit against evidence, create tailored PDFs and application materials, update the canonical tracker, and prepare outreach drafts for human review.
project.north_star: High-fit opportunities become clear and actionable while unsupported applications, provider-generated noise, and unsent external actions remain out of the workflow.
not_this: A source of truth based on provider newsletters or stale intermediary links
An agent that submits applications or sends outreach without human control

mvp.definition: An official posting can be resolved, evaluated, tailored into reviewed application artifacts, recorded in the canonical tracker, and accompanied by a Gmail draft without submission or sending.

complete_product.definition: Career Ops reliably manages the evidence-bound lifecycle from official posting discovery through evaluation, tailored materials, tracker reconciliation, draft-only outreach, and human-controlled submission across supported providers.

outcomes.name: A role is promoted only when its official source and fit evidence meet the documented threshold, with unknowns preserved.

layers.intended: The user can tell why a role is a fit and which claims remain unresolved.
layers.planned: The product documents official-posting resolution, evaluation, tracker, and artifact stages.
layers.implemented: The repository contains ingestion, evaluation, application-artifact, tracker, queue, and Gmail-draft workflows.
layers.verified: Repository workflow evidence and current safety boundaries are documented; this bootstrap did not submit an application or send mail.

evidence.note: Defines the full job-search command-center lifecycle and human-in-loop boundary.
Defines product purpose, evidence rules, and controlled external actions.

blockers.summary: Provider-native submission and live recruiter response remain human-controlled and are not product verification claims.

outcomes.name: Verified role decisions project into tailored materials, canonical tracker records, and draft-only outreach without silently sending or submitting.

layers.intended: Application work remains useful, reversible, and auditable until the human takes the final external action.
layers.planned: The project separates tracker reconciliation, PDF artifacts, Gmail drafts, and submission boundaries.
layers.implemented: The repository includes material generation and draft workflows with provenance gates.
layers.verified: Local artifact and draft behavior is documented; provider-native end-to-end parity was not executed here.

evidence.note: Describes tailored artifacts, tracker state, and draft-only outreach.
Separates prepared work from human-controlled submission and sending.

blockers.summary: Human review, provider authentication, and provider-native application state remain required for external completion.

verified.note: Repository-recorded evidence rules; no external submission or send was performed.

drift.summary: Prepared application artifacts and drafts are implemented locally, while provider-native submission, sending, and recruiter response remain outside the verified product boundary.
